content:
anya: quick heads-up: after the Faraday/net-http-persistent bump some CI runs for ruby-sampleapp show an intermittent auth-retry hang (spec: auth_retry_spec). failing ~20% of runs.

lee: can you paste the failing job and the gem changes?

anya: job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sampleapp/actions/runs/1240000000 (internal)
Gems: faraday 1.x -> 2.0, net-http-persistent 3.x -> 4.0. small adapter wiring tweak.

lee: likely connection reuse semantics changed. short-term: mark the spec flaky in CI. long-term: add a small `reset_connection!` on our HTTP client that gets called after a successful token refresh following 401. avoids relying on adapter internals.

anya: will open a tiny PR with reset_connection!, a unit test asserting it's called after refresh, and a temporary `:flake` label. also add a quick smoke job that runs auth-refresh on PRs touching `ruby/`.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by @anya — queued. :arrows_counterclockwise:

lee: nit: check `@conn&.closed?` before calling finish to avoid Errno on some net-http-persistent versions. add a changelog note for compatibility.

anya: thanks, pushed the fix and test. PR #483 (internal). CI green on rerun. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI rerun: successful.

lee: thanks — please backport to release branch and add release note: "ruby-sampleapp: make HTTP client resilient to connection reuse after auth refresh (compat Faraday 2.x / net-http-persistent 4.x)"

anya: will do.
